purpose: To allow users to select their preferred platform (PC, Xbox, PlayStation) to download and play VALORANT, and to provide options for creating a Riot Account or downloading the companion app.
summary: This page serves as a platform selection hub for VALORANT, allowing users to choose between PC, Xbox Series X|S, and PlayStation 5 to download the game. It highlights cross-progression and cross-inventory features and provides links to create a Riot Account and download the Riot Mobile Companion App.
